title: Oviduct
summary: O'VIDUCT, noun [Latin ovum, an egg, and ductus, a duct.] In animals, a passage for the egg from the ovary to the womb, or a passage which conveys the egg from the ovary.

inlines.v: O'VIDUCT, noun [Latin ovum, an egg, and ductus, a duct.] In animals, a passage for the egg from the ovary to the womb, or a passage which conveys the egg from the ovary.
